test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

PLC : EOT :: DLG : IOH :: HCN : ?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/234dab635b9b5007370f5b0200af5ff42f717e1472d9a78590a9f0afadafe6de.png] 

**Logic: **(4), (3) and (2) are added in the first, second and third letter's positional value and written diagonally.

PLC : EOT →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20f56d98a7bab185b9f3ffb06d238b99dc0360d6244792c12ad48708bc959323.png] 

DLG : IOH →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60b48119339d9e2302a966d027abac9ede710aef704897c3e8663709658a8cc4.png] 

Similarly, for 'HCN : ?' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/598d51481cb6fc3c8550efe6c9a813478e605adee8e149248b423ebf9bdf8882.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "PFL".
